topic.source_contract: protected-species surveys, planning standing advice, mitigation licences, district licensing and monitoring

scope_guards: A desk-study record is not treated as confirmed presence or absence.
A planning survey is not treated as authority to disturb a protected species.
A survey licence is not treated as a mitigation licence.
Planning permission is not treated as a Natural England licence.
District-level licensing availability is not treated as scheme enrolment or approval to start.
Proposed mitigation is not treated as installed, managed or successful habitat.
Old or out-of-season surveys are not silently treated as current.
No score or promotion is written without current surveys, decision, licence, implementation and monitoring evidence.
